# evidence/v0.1.3.2 - receipts behind the v0.1.3.2 README and CHANGELOG

The v0.1.3.2 ship gate (shipped exe against v0.1.3.1, Radeon 890M, llama-server, greedy): per cell `*-state.json`
(launch arguments), one `*.json` per timed request, `*.timeline.csv`, `*.preflight.json` and `*.rounds.json`.
`rg132p-pooled.txt` (Flash-Next, Ornith) and `rg132w-q27sx8-pooled.txt` (Qwen3.8 27B, S-X8) are the pooled verdicts;
`rg-*-READ.txt` are per-row reads derived from the request json by the export's `rg_read.py`. `rg-q27-10102007` and
`rg-sx8-10102026` are the second A cells that set the 27B floors. `kvzp-10091505` / `kvzo-10100057` = the MTP stale-K
probe on v0.1.3.1 and on the fix. `cellAI-10100632`, `cellAB-10090143`, `cellX-10080605`, `ab19r-10090621` and
`c31-10091916` are the per-change A/Bs the CHANGELOG cites. `v0132rev-version.txt` and `build-v0132rev-PROVENANCE.txt`
name the shipped exe (sha256 inside); `v0132-tail-diffstat.txt` shows the tip after it adds tools only.
Client and server process logs are not copied. Shas in these files name the source tree before this repository's
export rewrite; paths are the measuring machine's. Copied with the export's replace-text rules. sha256 below.
